content_sections.heading: TMC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the TMC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download TMC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: TMC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Engineer (Civil Engg.): First Class Diploma in Civil Engineering (Full Time course, 03 years after 10th Std. OR 02 years after 10+2 Std.) from Institutes approved by State Board of Technical Examination with 03 years post qualification experience with an established firm in supervision, quality control, billing of construction of multi storey buildings. Pharmacist: Full Time B. Pharm with minimum 01-year experience of working in Dispensary / Pharmacy of the hospital having minimum 100 beds OR D. Pharm with minimum 3 years of experience of working in a Dispensary / Pharmacy of the hospital having minimum 100 beds. Registration with State Pharmacy Council with duly allotted Registration Number is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the TMC Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Engineer (Civil Engg.) post, a First Class Diploma in Civil Engineering with 3 years of post-qualification experience is required. Specific details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Engineer (Civil Engg.) post ranges from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 30,000/- per month. For the Pharmacist post, the salary is Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these TMC vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an MCQ Test followed by a Skill Test for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) office in Sangrur, Punjab. Specific address details are in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q10. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Junior Engineer (Civil Engg.) and Pharmacist.
